name: Trouble getting into account
description: Reviewers say the app blocks access to their account and shows too many ads.

name: Password not accepted
description: Reviewers report the app rejects their password when they try to log in.

name: Premium changes feel unfair
description: Reviewers feel a recent update pushed features behind premium, making the app useless without paying.

name: Basic features locked behind premium
description: Reviewers say skipping, song choice, and queue controls now require a premium subscription, which they find unfair.

name: Missing songs and genres
description: Reviewers say the app lacks certain music, including gospel and reggae, and many songs are unavailable.

name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent
description: Reviewers report lyrics sometimes fail to appear, and availability differs between songs.

name: Downloads get stuck
description: Reviewers say songs stall while downloading in the background until they reopen Spotify.

name: Offline playback not working
description: Reviewers report that offline listening does not work for them.

name: General negative sentiment
description: Reviewers express dissatisfaction with the app overall, often criticising recent updates without specifics.

name: Wi-Fi connection problems
description: Reviewers say the app fails to connect over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some song quality is poor.

name: App crashes after update
description: Reviewers report the app crashes or will not open following a recent update.

name: Google Assistant playback fails
description: Reviewers say Google Assistant reports playing a playlist but the songs do not start.

name: Stuck on loading screen
description: Reviewers say the app freezes on the loading or logo screen and never finishes starting.

name: Playback stops unexpectedly
description: Reviewers report music stops halfway and does not resume where it left off, starting a new song instead.

name: Too many ads
description: Reviewers complain of frequent, loud ads between songs, especially for free users without premium.

name: Home screen and playlist changes
description: Reviewers dislike the new home screen layout and unwanted recommendations cluttering their playlists.

name: Can't play chosen songs
description: Reviewers say songs shuffle randomly within playlists and they cannot choose or skip tracks freely.

name: Player controls and autoplay issues
description: Reviewers report autoplaying audio elements with no setting to disable them, and missing basic player controls like rewind.
